eval: (async () => { AS.App.startOnline({}); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 900));  return JSON.stringify({ step: 'create', room: AS.App.room, mode: AS.App.mode, screen: AS.App.screen, phase: AS.App.phase, status: AS.App.status, n: AS.App.snap && AS.App.snap.players.length, me: AS.App.me() && AS.App.me().name, host: AS.App.isHost() }); })()

(async () => { const code = AS.App.room.code; window.__code = code; const ws = new WebSocket(location.origin.replace('http', 'ws') + '/ws'); window.__ws = ws; await new Promise(r => ws.onopen = r); ws.send(JSON.stringify({ t: 'hello', v: 1, name: 'Bob', color: 'blue' })); ws.send(JSON.stringify({ t: 'join', code })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 700));  return JSON.stringify({ step: 'second player', n: AS.App.snap.players.length, toasts: [...document.querySelectorAll('.app-toast')].map(e => e.textContent) }); })()

(async () => { AS.App.send({ type: 'addBot' }); AS.App.send({ type: 'addBot' }); AS.App.send({ type: 'settings', settings: { votingTime: 30 } }); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500));  return JSON.stringify({ step: 'host actions', n: AS.App.snap.players.length, votingTime: AS.App.snap.settings.votingTime, prefsVoting: AS.App.prefs.settings.votingTime }); })()

(async () => { const bob = AS.App.snap.players.find(p => p.name === 'Bob'); AS.App.send({ type: 'setLook', color: bob.color }); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500));  return JSON.stringify({ step: 'colorTaken', toasts: [...document.querySelectorAll('.app-toast')].map(e => e.textContent), profileColor: AS.App.profile.color }); })()

(async () => { AS.App.send({ type: 'setLook', color: 'lime', hat: 'papaq' }); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500));  return JSON.stringify({ step: 'setLook ok', me: AS.App.me().color + '/' + AS.App.me().hat, profile: AS.App.profile.color + '/' + AS.App.profile.hat }); })()

(async () => { const m = AS.App.me(); AS.App.send({ type: 'move', x: m.x + 7, y: m.y, facing: -1, moving: false }); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400));  return JSON.stringify({ step: 'move', x: AS.App.me().x - m.x, tp: AS.App.me().tp }); })()

(async () => { window.__ws.send(JSON.stringify({ t: 'leave' })); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500));  return JSON.stringify({ step: 'bob left', n: AS.App.snap.players.length, toasts: [...document.querySelectorAll('.app-toast')].map(e => e.textContent) }); })()

(async () => { AS.App.leave(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300));  return JSON.stringify({ step: 'leave', screen: AS.App.screen, mode: AS.App.mode, tr: !!AS.App.transport, snap: !!AS.App.snap }); })()

(async () => { AS.App.startOnline({ code: 'zzzz' }); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 900));  return JSON.stringify({ step: 'bad code', screen: AS.App.screen, mode: AS.App.mode, tr: !!AS.App.transport, toasts: [...document.querySelectorAll('.app-toast')].map(e => e.textContent) }); })()

(async () => { AS.App.startOnline({ url: '127.0.0.1:3999' }); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2500));  return JSON.stringify({ step: 'no server', screen: AS.App.screen, mode: AS.App.mode, tr: !!AS.App.transport, toasts: [...document.querySelectorAll('.app-toast')].map(e => e.textContent) }); })()
